name: Swift Energy Technology Berhad
overview: 今年公司主要围绕与 Gutor Electronic Asia Pacific Sdn Bhd 于 2025 年 12 月 8 日签订的谅解备忘录（MOU）进行多次状态更新，该 MOU 有效期至 2026 年 12 月 7 日，双方均未表示撤回意向。此外，公司发生公司秘书变更及地址变更等公司事务。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增 94.4%，净利润同比增 203.9%。
overview_en: During the year, the Company mainly provided several status updates on the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) entered into with Gutor Electronic Asia Pacific Sdn Bhd on 8 December 2025, which remains valid until 7 December 2026 with neither party indicating an intention to withdraw. The Company also had changes of company secretary and change of address. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue increased 94.4% YoY and net profit increased 203.9% YoY.
